title: NegotiationToM: A Benchmark for Stress-testing Machine Theory of Mind on Negotiation Surrounding
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking Theory of Mind (ToM) in negotiation scenarios, specifically tracking mental states like desires, beliefs, and intentions. It contains a standard ethics statement regarding data usage and privacy, and briefly references the development of morality to define the concept of belief, but it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics.
